description: Référentiel des gares de voyageurs en Pays de la Loire is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Région des Pays de la Loire. Reference for passenger stations in the Pays de la Loire Definition of “DRG segment”: Category A: passenger stations of national interest. These stations are those where passengers on domestic and international passenger services are at least 250,000 passengers per year or whose passengers represent 100 % of the passengers. Category B: regional passenger stations. Coverage: Région des Pays de la Loire. The portal shows the English title as "Reference for passenger stations in Pays de la Loire" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Région des Pays de la Loire. Its keywords include gare-ferroviaire, mobilite. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, SHP, GEOJSON, JSON. The listing shows 2023-10-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
